headline: Ukraine struck 1,500 km deep into Russia. A huge refinery is in its sights
summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck one of Russia's largest petrochemical complexes in Bashkortostan, about 1,500 km from its border. The report describes the target as a major refinery.
why: Strikes on Russian refineries can reduce refined fuel output and affect global oil product markets and sanctions-sensitive energy trade.
original_headline: Ukraina uderzyła 1500 km w głąb Rosji. Na celowniku ogromna rafineria
